summary:
The slice does what the design asked, and I confirmed it by running it. On the tree as committed at 912b6ac, the full suite passes 1111/1111, fitness passes (102 rules), and window case T-013 passes. In the T-013 run, 13 rows the store reports unfinished draw the store's bound in full, 419 ancestors read 'at least' up to the root, the 4 final rows draw their rolled figures with no word, the stopped list matches the tree, the tree header's sentence is drawn (107 characters shown; it ends at 101), and a completed scan shows 'at least' nowhere. That run was at 100% DPI with a 1032 DIP work area, and 'at least 1,023 bytes' still measured 101.26 DIP in the 102 DIP cell.

The one thing to send back is a defect in the seam census that discharges O-018. AtLeastSeamTests finds who constructs an AtLeastFigures by looking only for `newobj` (0x73) in Core's IL. The corpus says 'a target-typed new(), var, a ternary or a local function all compile to the same newobj', and that is false. I compiled a probe in Debug and in Release: `var b = new S(..)`, `S b = new(..)` and `S b; b = new(..)` all compile to `call .ctor` (0x28). I then planted `AtLeastFigures forged; forged = new(r.Bytes, r.OnDisk, (int)r.Files);` in TopLevelTracker.WithAtLeast, restored the file and rebuilt afterwards. With the plant, AtLeastSeamTests stayed 6/6 green and both patterns of fitness rule 2 stayed quiet. Only a behavioural fact noticed, and only because the forgery was in the one method that fact drives.

One minor item goes to the backlog: the stopped outcome panel's totals, the largest-files list and the kinds still draw unfinished figures with no mark, next to a tree root that reads 'at least 0 bytes'. No criterion asked for those surfaces.

The other undeclared departures are small and recorded under drift. There is no loop: there was one build attempt, and code reviews 1-3 never ran because of provider errors.

Second round: This second pass, aimed at breaking the code rather than reading it against the design, finds one new minor defect. Round 1's M1 still stands and is not repeated here.

Fitness rule 1 ('the at-least word is composed only in TopLevelRowText') is what the corpus and the design doc rely on to keep the App from putting the word on a number by hand. It reads only App *.cs files, and within them only one line at a time. I ran its two patterns on three C# spellings and all three stayed quiet:
- the word and FormatSize split over two lines;
- the word read through a local variable (`string w = TopLevelRowText.AtLeastWord;`);
- the size formatted into a string first and then interpolated after the word.

A XAML `StringFormat='at least {0}'` on a binding is never read at all. The project already gives App rules a separate *.xaml entry for exactly this reason (the SL-044 'does not sort the folder tree in its XAML either' entries).

The two cells drawn today are still held at runtime by T-013's C1 and C3 checks, which I re-ran in round 1. A new cell, such as the one Q-292's follow-up will add, would not be.

Other boundaries I checked turned up nothing new:
- Nothing in the App keys on `TopLevelSnapshot.Sequence`, so the marked copy reusing the original's sequence number is harmless.
- No string literal in MainWindow.xaml.cs or FolderTreeNode.cs contains `//` or `/*`, so the comment-stripping wiring test cannot misread them.
- The JSON corpus has no BOM or comment hazards.
- The IL byte scanner's loop bounds are correct.
- The bound arithmetic cannot go negative.
- Every number on a marked list line is preceded by the word, so the line's CharacterEllipsis trimming can cut a figure but never shows one unmarked.
- The uncontained throw at the ending is review m2, already deferred.

findings.claim: The IL census that O-018's closure rests on misses every in-place construction of the bound. OnlyTheStoreMakesABoundAndOnlyTheTrackerReadsItAndPutsItOnARow looks for the constructor token only after `newobj`. Roslyn compiles initialising a struct local (`var b = new AtLeastFigures(..)`, `AtLeastFigures b = new(..)`) and assigning one later (`AtLeastFigures b; b = new(..)`) as `ldloca; call .ctor` (0x28), in Debug and in Release alike; I measured this with a probe build. The corpus note says the opposite ('a target-typed new(), var, a ternary or a local function all compile to the same newobj'). I planted `AtLeastFigures forged; forged = new(r.Bytes, r.OnDisk, (int)r.Files);` in TopLevelTracker.WithAtLeast and put it on the row. AtLeastSeamTests stayed 6/6 green, and neither pattern of fitness rule 2 ('only the store constructs a lower bound') matched either line. So a bound forged from listing figures anywhere in Core (for example by Q-292's follow-up) gets past both guards that claim to close the class. Today's tree is clean; the closure claim is not.
findings.evidence: tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/AtLeastSeamTests.cs:116 scans opcodes [0x73] only. tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/AtLeastSeamCorpus.json producers._note makes the newobj claim. Probe (Debug and Release): ReturnNew newobj=True; LocalVar, LocalTargetTyped and Deferred call=True, newobj=False; Out and Nullable newobj=True. Plant run: AtLeastSeamTests passed 6/6, rule-2 regexes false on both planted lines, and only ARebuiltRowKeepsEveryPropertyItHad went red. The file was restored and rebuilt, and the tree is clean.
findings.fix: Scan the constructor token under both newobj and call: `Callers(CoreAssembly, [0x73, 0x28], constructor.MetadataToken)`. Correct the producers _note in AtLeastSeamCorpus.json. Add corpus rows for the three in-place spellings (`var b = new AtLeastFigures(..)`, `AtLeastFigures b = new(..)`, `AtLeastFigures b; b = new(..)`), each recorded as compiling to `call .ctor`. Show the census goes red on the deferred-assignment plant in a non-store Core method.
findings.class_of: rolled or listing figure spellings reaching AtLeastSize

findings.claim: After a Stop, several surfaces still draw non-final figures with no mark: the outcome panel's totals line (the root's rolled RolledSize and RolledOnDisk), the volume line built from them, the largest-files list (charged sizes of files whose check is pending) and the kinds. In the tree on the same screen, the root row and those same pending files read 'at least 0 bytes'. After a Stop in the listing, the person sees, for example, '1.2 GB in files' above a root that reads 'at least 0 bytes'. That contradicts the slice goal 'any figure without a mark is final'. The criteria named only the tree and the top-level rows, so this was not required.
findings.evidence: src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs:628-633 (OutcomeDetailText from result.Totals); :728 (LargestFileRow from ChargedOnDisk and ChargedSize); ShowKinds(result) at :681. All of these run for Cancelled results.
findings.fix: Leave it to design-slice or the Q-292 follow-up. Under MarksAtLeast, either word the totals line from AtLeast(0) through TopLevelRowText, or label the totals and the largest-files sizes as 'as listed'.
findings.class_of: stopped-ending surfaces drawing a non-final figure without 'at least'

findings.claim: Rule 1 misses several ordinary ways to put the at-least word in front of a rolled or listing figure in the App. The corpus's composers note and the design doc say FolderTreeNode is held by this rule (and T-013), and the rule's own 'because' text says the composers are 'the only way to put the word on a number'. But the rule reads only `src/FsAnalyser.App/**/*.cs`, and its second pattern needs AtLeastWord and FormatSize( on one line with no ';' between them. Measured with its own regexes, it stays quiet on: (S2) `$"{TopLevelRowText.AtLeastWord} " +` with `FigureText.FormatSize(Size)` on the next line; (S3) `string w = TopLevelRowText.AtLeastWord;` followed by `$"{w} {FigureText.FormatSize(Size)}"`; (S4) `string s = FigureText.FormatSize(Size);` followed by `$"{TopLevelRowText.AtLeastWord} {s}"`. It never reads XAML, so a binding such as `Text="{Binding Size, StringFormat='at least {0}'}"` on a new cell gets past every guard: rule 1, the type closure (no composer is called) and the IL census (Core only). Each of these words a rolled figure, which can sit above the final one, as a bound. Today's Size and On disk cells are still held at runtime by T-013's C1 and C3 checks; any new cell (for example Q-292's follow-up) is not.
findings.evidence: Rule 1 at .taad/fitness.yaml:1395-1398: S1 (one line) fires, S2, S3 and S4 are quiet (PowerShell regex run of its two patterns). The *.xaml precedent is the SL-044 pair 'the window does not sort the folder tree in its XAML either' (fitness.yaml:587-590, files: src/FsAnalyser.App/*.xaml), kept separate because 'files takes one glob'. A candidate XAML pattern, `="[^"]*\bat least\b`, has 0 hits on today's App XAML, so the three XAML comments that mention 'at least' (MainWindow.xaml:151, 163, 472) stay quiet. tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/AtLeastSeamCorpus.json composers._note names the rule as FolderTreeNode's guard.
findings.fix:
1. Add a twin rule-1 entry over `src/FsAnalyser.App/**/*.xaml` with pattern `="[^"]*\bat least\b` (quiet on today's XAML), plus a plant row that puts StringFormat='at least {0}' on a TextBlock.
2. Add rows to AtLeastSeamCorpus.json for S2, S3, S4 and the XAML StringFormat, each recorded as getting past the text rule and held only by T-013 C1/C3 on the existing cells.
3. Reword rule 1's 'because' text and the composers _note to call rule 1 a tripwire for the spellings named, not the way the App is kept from composing the word.
findings.class_of: rolled or listing figure spellings reaching AtLeastSize

obligations.evidence: In T-013 (re-run here), m-mid and the root draw 'at least' with no note. StoppedTopLevelTests.AFolderWithNoFileBelowIsMarkedThroughAnUnreadFolderBelowIt covers the arm where only NotListedAtOrBelow marks the folder.

$T013Needs is VOID unless b-listed's storeAtLeast.size differs from storeRolled.size. The 'none of the 13 rows whose bound differs' check passed. The TreeAtLeastRolled mutant is pinned in WindowMutants.ps1.
T-013 requires b-listed\b1.bin with entryKind File and storeUnfinished true, and checks it draws 'at least 0 bytes' in both cells. It passed here.

TreeMode.CellFit measures the widest 'at least ' + FormatSize over all units against the realized cells, and WindowCases checks both cells. Here: 101.26 DIP in 102 at 100% DPI. MainWindow.xaml cells and headings are at 102.
T-013 C2 checked 419 ancestors and passed. StoppedTopLevelTests.Judge (lines 345-350) checks that every unread or unfinished entry has an unfinished parent, including the two-hop q->a->sNN chain.
CheckAtLeastTree's final-names check covers a-empty, b-listed\empty, b-listed\denied and c-prefix, and all 4 final rows drew their rolled figures with no word.
CheckAtLeastList compares by name: 2 marked rows equal the store's bound and the tree cells, final rows start with storeRolled, and NotRead rows are unworded. It passed here.
StoppedTopLevelTests.AssertSnapshotsAgree pins every public property by reflection. ARebuiltRowKeepsEveryPropertyItHad carries Revised, FailedKind and UnreadableBelow through the rebuild.
Judge asserts NotSame when any row is marked and Same otherwise (tallies New>=10, Reused>=5), and that the published rows' AtLeast stays null.
ANoStoreToMarkIsReturnedAsItIsAndNeverRead covers a pre-cancelled scan (Count 0), RootUnreadable, Refused, Completed, a hand-built completed store with an unread folder, and an empty stopped store.
Test-T014's VOID rule requires notListedChildren>=5000 and atLeastRealized>=1, and each of the 5 opens must be under 500 ms with at most 200 rows built. The builder ran it; I did not re-run T-014.
T-013 run 2 (re-run here) shows no 'at least' in rows or hook lines. In the diff, only $StoppedListHeader and $StoppedSizingHeader moved among existing expectations.
The NoTreeAtLeast and NoListAtLeast entries in WindowMutants.ps1 have exactly-once Finds and pinned FAIL lines. The builder reports 16/16; I did not re-run the mutants.
MainWindow.StoppedTreeHeader promises only sizes, and the shares clause says 'as listed'. CheckAtLeastHeader rejects any 'shares...final' sentence.

The sentence ends at index 101, and T-013 checks headerCharsShown at 880 px against it (107 here). The ListHeader comment and the design doc say the list size clause is reachable only through the tooltip.

The type half holds: src/FsAnalyser.Core/AtLeastFigures.cs has an internal constructor, get-only properties and is not a record, and the composers take only the bound. The producer census in AtLeastSeamTests.cs:116 scans only newobj, so in-place constructions escape both it and rule 2 (finding M1, demonstrated by a plant).

docs/design/SL-113-stopped-at-least.md 'What validate runs' lists the suite, harness.py --engine-root, RuleCases C-001/C-003, T-003 with Q-279, the tree and layout cases, -Mutant All and the tests/bugs projects.

MainWindow.BuildFolderTree passes result.MarksAtLeast, and FolderTreeNode.Bound is gated by _session.ReadsBounds. AtLeastSeamTests.TheTreeAsksTheStoreForABoundOnlyUnderTheListsGuard holds the wiring as text. The doc corrects the criterion-6 reasoning.
T-013 C1 passed here: 13 unfinished rows drew 'at least '+bound, unclipped.
T-013's 'bound differs from rolled' check plus the TreeAtLeastRolled mutant entry.
The b-listed\b1.bin line passed here.
C2 passed here with 419 ancestors.

In StoppedTopLevelTests.AFolderWithNoFileBelowIsMarkedThroughAnUnreadFolderBelowIt, q has only empty a\sNN folders. The test asserts the bound is (0,0,0), that no file lies under q, and that at least 5 such Stops occur.
T-013 C3 and the final-names line passed here.
WithAtLeast skips NotListed rows. Judge asserts AtLeast is null on unread rows. C4 checks NotRead rows are unworded, and the tree's HasFigures gate is unchanged.
C4 passed here with 2 marked rows matching the tree.
Judge's NotSame/Same assertions (StoppedTopLevelTests.cs:333-342). The window race itself is covered only at Core level, as the design planned.
AStopInTheSizeChecksMarksOnlyTheRowsWithAPendingCheck: 6 real Stops inside probe calls, with StoppedInSizeChecks asserted and at least one Stop leaving a marked row beside a final one.
T-013 run 2 passed here. The guard itself is pinned by the hand-built completed-with-unread fact.
ANoStoreToMarkIsReturnedAsItIsAndNeverRead, including Assert.Throws on emptyStore.Unfinished(0).
Test-T014 as written. Bound is read lazily per realized row and never in EnsureChildren (FolderTreeNode.cs:139-157). Not re-run by me.
CheckAtLeastHeader passed here: the list header equals the new constant and the tree header's sentence is drawn, 107 >= 101.
Owed to validate. The checks exist and pass: Judge's every-entry parent check on each listing and size-check Stop (including a two-hop chain), and T-013 C2 (419 ancestors) re-run here.

cases.evidence: T-013 stops New-StoppedTreeFixture at m-mid\ (a Stop in the listing, watermark 0). The C1 check over 13 store-unfinished rows passed in my run.
$T013Needs is VOID unless b-listed's storeAtLeast.size differs from storeRolled.size, so the shape is required for the case to count. The rolled-vs-bound check passed.
VOID unless b-listed\b1.bin is entryKind File with storeUnfinished true. It drew 'at least 0 bytes' in both cells.
C2 walks the parents of every unread and marked row to the root (419 here). Judge checks the parent of every entry on real Stops.
The q\a\s00..s29 tree has no files under q. The test asserts the row bound is (0,0,0) via NotListedAtOrBelow and that no file lies under q, over at least 5 Stops.
T-013 requires a-empty, b-listed\empty, b-listed\denied and c-prefix to be store-final and to draw rolled figures with no word.
Judge asserts AtLeast is null on NotListed rows. C4 rejects 'at least' on NotRead list rows (p00-p04 are present in the fixture).
CheckAtLeastList compares each depth-1 tree row to its list row by name: 2 marked (b-listed Done, m-mid StoppedPartway).

Covered as the design planned, at Core level: StoppedTopLevel returns a new object whenever any row is marked and the original otherwise. No window test drives an actual tick that showed the final snapshot before the ending.
Six real Stops inside probe calls (n=1, 9, 100, due/2, due-3, due) with StoppedInSizeChecks asserted true, and the marked set compared to the walk oracle.
T-013 run 2 scans the same tree to Completed. It cannot tell the guard apart from an empty store answer, but the hand-built Completed-with-unread-folder fact and the wiring text check cover that.
A pre-cancelled scan with Count 0 and TopLevel null, RootUnreadable, Refused, and a hand-built empty stopped store all assert MarksAtLeast false and the same snapshot back.

Test-T014's VOID rule requires at least 5,000 NotListed children and atLeastRealized >= 1 on open 1, and every open re-checks atLeastRealized >= 1. The builder ran it (77.0 ms cold); I did not re-run it.

CheckAtLeastHeader compares the exact strings and headerCharsShown at 880 px against the sentence end (107 >= 101 here). The list size clauses are declared tooltip-only, and no check claims they are drawn.

drift: The corpus note in tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/AtLeastSeamCorpus.json says var, target-typed new() and the other spellings 'all compile to the same newobj'. Measured, they compile to call .ctor for struct locals. The design doc repeats that the IL census is the closure (see M1).

Design fact (e) was to run 'on a ragged tree (lesson #511)'. The build runs it on NotListedTests.SweepTree (listing Stops), on the q\a chain tree and on UnfinishedTests.StopTree (size-check Stops), not on NotListedBelowTests.RaggedTree. This was not declared. The q\a tree does give a two-hop NotListedAtOrBelow chain, so propagation is still exercised.

The design named the cell-fit probe 'at least 1,000 bytes'. The hook measures the widest of 'at least ' + FormatSize over every unit, which is 'at least 1,023 bytes'. The width is the same (101.26 DIP). Not declared, and it does no harm.

$T013Needs has extra VOID requirements (b-listed's bound must differ from its rolled figure, and b-listed\b1.bin must be a pending file) beyond the design's two. This strengthens the case and was not declared.

Measured here at 100% DPI with a 1032 DIP work area (the display has changed since the build's 125%/816 DIP runs): the widest figure is still 101.26 DIP in a 102 cell, and the tree header shows 107 characters. This answers part of Q-301's 100% question for this machine. 150% DPI and larger text are still unmeasured.
CheckAtLeastList in WindowCases.ps1 computes $revised and never uses it (dead code, no effect).
unreviewed: .taad/slices/SL-113/*.json (stage records, not code; only index.json read)
